hypothesis: A leveraged ETF with positive prior-session primary-market creation that trades below a SPY-implied, prior-NAV-anchored fair value after the next cash open will converge during the first hour.

signal.availability: one US trading session after the creation source date
signal.creation_condition: selected fund's estimated flow dollars strictly greater than 0.01
signal.prior_nav: official ProShares source-day NAV converted back to point-in-time units by reversing every later official split
signal.spy_observation: close of the OHLCV-1m bar stamped 09:31 ET; the timestamp is interval start and the bar is complete at 09:32
signal.upro_residual: (UPRO midpoint / prior UPRO NAV - 1) / 3 - (SPY bar close / prior SPY close - 1)
signal.spxu_residual: (SPXU midpoint / prior SPXU NAV - 1) / 3 + (SPY bar close / prior SPY close - 1)
signal.upro_action: UPRO creation positive and UPRO residual strictly negative
signal.spxu_action: SPXU creation positive and SPXU residual strictly negative
signal.both_qualify: select the strictly more negative residual in underlying units; exact tie is cash

execution.primary_feed: existing Databento ARCX.PILLAR UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m already stored in the repo
execution.independent_feed: existing Databento EQUS.MINI SPY OHLCV-1m and UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m already stored in the repo
execution.delayed_entry_stress: observed ask at exactly 09:38 ET with unchanged 10:30 exit
execution.extra_cost_stress: add one cent per share to entry and subtract one cent per share from exit

development.holdout_lock: Do not calculate a 2024-2025 feature, strategy, control, or benchmark outcome unless every development gate passes.

controls.discount_only: ignore flow and buy the fund with the more negative residual whenever at least one residual is negative
controls.creation_only: among funds with positive creation, buy the lower-residual fund even if that residual is positive
controls.redemption_conditioned_discount: apply the actual negative-residual selection to funds with negative flow
controls.extra_lag_creation_discount: replace current available creation signs with those from the preceding trading session while retaining current residuals
controls.creation_conditioned_premium_continuatio: among positively created funds with positive residual, buy the strictly richer fund

benchmark.requirement: strategy compounded ending cash must be strictly greater

forbidden_repairs: alternate SPY or wrapper signal clock
replace NAV with prior market close after outcome inspection
favorable year, weekday, volatility, or gap subset
opening 2024-2025 after any failed development gate
